description: This file contains ARM Cortex-A R architecture-specific code for symmetric multiprocessing (SMP) in Zephyr OS, including CPU startup, secondary CPU initialization, inter-processor interrupts (IPIs), and related SMP infrastructure.

methods.name: arch_start_cpu
methods.description: Initializes and starts a secondary CPU core, setting up its stack pointers and synchronization.

methods.name: arch_secondary_cpu_init
methods.description: Performs secondary CPU core initialization, including MPU/MMU setup and GIC configuration, then runs the assigned thread function.

methods.name: arch_smp_init
methods.description: Initializes SMP infrastructure, including setting up the primary core MPID and configuring the IPI handler.

methods.name: sched_ipi_handler
methods.description: Handles scheduling IPIs received by cores.

methods.name: arch_sched_ipi
methods.description: Broadcasts a scheduling IPI to all other cores.
